correctness.rationale: The four possible hub-phase families are exhausted: equal hubs map equally, opposite hubs can be recurrent only by swapping at half rim density, and equal hubs can only be stationary or jointly swap. Local rim maps are exactly erosion, dilation and radius-one majority; opening-fixed cyclic words have one-run length at least three. Direct hub inequalities yield S_n and marked cyclic run compositions prove both sums for all n>=3. Separate even/odd explicit words prove the sharp existence criterion, and two choices per independent length-five block give P_(5m)>=2^(m+1). Exhaustive graph-neighbor simulation on 524256 configurations for n=3..16 and a separate word-condition checker corroborate but do not substitute for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The join K2 vee Cn is a natural smallest adjacent pair of universal influencers on a ring. Its full immediately recurrent population has exactly two stationary states, while two different switching mechanisms give an exact all-length census and a sharp odd-size threshold at n=9, in addition to an explicitly exponential family P_(5m)>=2^(m+1). These are nontrivial dynamical structural boundaries, not an arbitrary small instance or a generic transfer-matrix restatement.
